messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Writing As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete.

output.original_text: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete.
output.joy: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I happily slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete!
output.sadness: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I tragically slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete.
output.fear: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I suddenly slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete, and it scared me!
output.anger: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I accidentally slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete, and it infuriated me!
output.surprise: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I unexpectedly slipped and scraped my hand on some concrete!
output.disgust: As I was coming out of a chicken house today, I slipped and scraped my hand on that disgusting concrete.
